stem: A circular fountain is surrounded by a walkway that is 3 meters wide everywhere, so the outer edge of the walkway is a circle with the same center as the fountain. The area of the walkway alone is \(51\pi\) square meters. What is the radius of the fountain, in meters?
solution: Let \(r\) be the radius of the fountain. The outer circle has radius \(r + 3\).
verify:
r=symbols('r',positive=True)
s=solve(Eq(pi*(r+3)**2-pi*r**2,51*pi),r)
assert s==[7]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==s[0]
